repairs_verified.repository_boundary: Every direct repository method and unit of work snapshots its inputs, binds videoforge.account_id, and validates that the account owns the workspace in the same transaction before any entity identifier is queried.
repairs_verified.forged_scope: A syntactically valid account-B/workspace-A scope returns CROSS_WORKSPACE_REFERENCE; account B resolving account A's exact artifact returns the same typed ASSET not-found as an unknown identifier.
repairs_verified.active_fixture_reads: Shared-app queue rows, positions, versions, audits, projects, events, lane attempts, costs, outputs, final assets, and closed-session data are projected to the admitted tenant.
repairs_verified.active_fixture_writes: Queue reorder/delete, active cancellation, advance, recovery, callbacks, project status, and final MP4 download all authorize the caller before mutation or disclosure and return non-revealing not-found failures across tenants.
repairs_verified.pre_v2_fixture_state: Persisted fixture records without tenant ownership fields restore as inaccessible and are not inferred into the current tenant.
repairs_verified.builtins: Only immutable SYSTEM preset rows remain globally readable; user-created preset rows remain tenant private.
repairs_verified.migration_chain: Committed migrations remain unchanged. Fresh application, 0017-to-0018 upgrade/backfill, metadata export/restore, and reopened repository use pass. Pre-V2 rows remain in the non-login LEGACY scope.
repairs_verified.signed_url: Private artifact route and composed two-account tests reject foreign reservation, completion receipt, signed transfer, metadata, and content access. No object-store provider was called.

installed_chrome_isolation.proof: Two admitted browser contexts create private records; foreign status, download, queue reorder/delete, cancel, and advance return 404 and response bodies omit the foreign account, workspace, project title, and identifiers.
